# regulated-delivery: what it prints

<!-- Generated by scripts/render_demos.py from real runs; do not edit by
     hand. CI fails when this file no longer matches the code. -->

Real output of [regulated-delivery](../../plugins/regulated-delivery) on the fixtures its own
tests use. Skills and subagents are not shown: what they say depends on the
model, and they are measured by the eval cases in the plugin's `evals/`.

## guard_pii blocks a customer's IBAN in a fixture

The IBAN passes the mod-97 check, so it could be real. Published test values and numbers with a wrong check digit go through.

Input:

```json
{
  "tool_name": "Write",
  "tool_input": {
    "file_path": "src/test/resources/customers.csv",
    "content": "id,name,iban\n1,Ana,ES60 0049 1500 0512 3456 7892\n"
  }
}
```

```console
$ python3 plugins/regulated-delivery/scripts/guard_pii.py < plugins/regulated-delivery/tests/fixtures/pii-iban-write.json
Blocked by guard_pii: line 2 of the text for src/test/resources/customers.csv holds an IBAN (ES60…7892) that passes its issuer's check, so it could belong to a real person. Nothing was written.
Do not retry with the value split, encoded or moved to another file. Instead:
- Test data: use a published test value (card 4111 1111 1111 1111, IBAN GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32 or ES91 2100 0418 4502 0005 1332, DNI 12345678Z), or one that fails its check digit on purpose.
- Real data the code needs: read it at runtime from where it is held, never from source or fixtures.
- If the user says this exact value is safe, ask them to add it to .claude/pii-guard-allow themselves.
[exit 2]
```

## guard_pii lets published test values through

No output and exit 0: the write goes ahead.

Input:

```json
{
  "tool_name": "Write",
  "tool_input": {
    "file_path": "src/test/java/PaymentTest.java",
    "content": "card = \"4111 1111 1111 1111\";\niban = \"GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32\";\nes = \"ES9121000418450200051332\";\ndni = \"12345678Z\";\n"
  }
}
```

```console
$ python3 plugins/regulated-delivery/scripts/guard_pii.py < plugins/regulated-delivery/tests/fixtures/pii-published-examples.json
[exit 0]
```
